class.name: DSPkg
class.brief_description: Builds and reads archives of DirectStorage texture payloads.
class.description: [DSPkg] packages existing [code].dstex[/code] files into a [code].dspkg[/code] archive without recompressing their payloads. Supports version 1, version 2, and version 3 archives. Version 2 archives store per-entry GPU mip metadata ([code]DSPkgMipEntry[/code]), enabling direct GPU streaming and hardware decompression from package files into VRAM. Version 3 archives additionally store 32-bit per-entry flags ([code]flags[/code]), preserving [code]is_srgb[/code] and [code]as_image_texture[/code] attributes across archive roundtrips. Use [method create], [method add_texture], and [method finalize] to build an archive. Use [method open] and the reader methods to inspect or extract entry data. The resource loader also uses [code]res://textures.dspkg[/code] for bundled texture lookups.

method.name: add_texture
method.description: Adds an existing [code].dstex[/code] file to an archive currently being built. [param mip_metadata] can provide per-mip footprint metadata ([code]mip_sizes[/code], [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code], [code]mip_row_pitches[/code]) for GPU mip metadata archive generation; if empty, metadata is read automatically from the source [code].dstex[/code] file. Call [method create] first.

method.name: create
method.description: Starts building a new archive at [param output_path]. Call [method add_texture] for each entry, then call [method finalize].

method.name: finalize
method.description: Writes the archive header, entry table, and staged payloads as a version 3 archive. If entries have GPU mip metadata, writes [code]DSPkgMipEntry[/code] tables. Each entry also serializes 32-bit entry flags (such as sRGB and ImageTexture compatibility). Returns an error if the archive is not being built or contains no textures.

method.name: get_entries
method.description: Returns an array of resource paths for all entries in the opened archive, or an empty array when no archive is open.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in the opened archive.

method.name: get_entry_info
method.description: Returns metadata for an entry, including [code]archive_path[/code] ([String]), [code]path[/code] ([String]), [code]data_offset[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]flags[/code] ([int]), [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] ([bool]), [code]is_srgb[/code] ([bool]), [code]as_image_texture[/code] ([bool]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]).

method.name: get_mip_entries_for_offset
method.description: Returns an array of [Dictionary] records representing the GPU mip entries located at absolute payload [param offset]. Each dictionary contains [code]offset[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]uncompressed_size[/code] ([int]), and [code]row_pitch[/code] ([int]). Returns an empty array if no mip entries match the offset or if no archive is open.

method.name: has_texture
method.description: Returns whether the opened archive contains [param resource_path].

method.name: open
method.description: Opens and validates a [code].dspkg[/code] archive (version 1, version 2, or version 3) for reading. A failed open clears any previously loaded archive state.

method.name: read_texture
method.description: Reads an entry's compressed payload and metadata. The result contains [code]path[/code] ([String]), [code]compressed_data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]width[/code] ([int]), [code]height[/code] ([int]), [code]pixel_format[/code] ([int]), [code]mip_count[/code] ([int]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] ([bool]), [code]mip_offsets[/code] ([PackedInt64Array]), [code]mip_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]mip_uncompressed_sizes[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), and [code]mip_row_pitches[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]). When [code]has_gpu_metadata[/code] is [code]true[/code], [code]mip_data[/code] ([Array] of [PackedByteArray]) is also provided containing individual mip slices.
